parameters.description: Reference extraction from eight document contexts carrying 12 untrusted instruction patterns.
parameters.limitations: Synthetic instruction-boundary diagnostics, not harmful-request jailbreak tests. The 96 cases reuse 12 attack templates across eight contexts; correlated variants are not 96 independent threats. Intervals summarize the selected cases and do not establish deployment safety.

parameters.description: Exact system-policy adherence across 12 benign override patterns and eight canaries.
parameters.limitations: Synthetic instruction-boundary diagnostics, not harmful-request jailbreak tests. The 96 cases reuse 12 attack templates across eight contexts; correlated variants are not 96 independent threats. Intervals summarize the selected cases and do not establish deployment safety.

parameters.description: Simulated read/write approval and forbidden data-access decisions, including allowed-action controls.
parameters.limitations: No real tools execute. Twelve scenarios repeat across eight asset names, so variants are correlated. This measures policy decisions, not long-horizon agent behavior.

parameters.description: 256 category-stratified TruthfulQA questions from upstream d71c110897f5d31c5d7f309e7bc316c152f6f031, converted to balanced binary choices and self-reported confidence.
parameters.limitations: This is an adaptation, not the official TruthfulQA MC1/MC2 metric. It uses the best correct and best incorrect answer and a seeded category-stratified subset. Confidence is self-reported, not token probability. Malformed JSON scores zero. Public benchmark contamination and selection effects may affect results.
